product_one_liner.value: Vertical Insure helps vertical SaaS platforms embed customized insurance into their customer experience, providing implementation, insurance operations, claims and customer support.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes an embedded-insurance platform for vertical SaaS, including implementation, insurance operations, claims and support: https://verticalinsure.com/.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the company website’s navigation/footer, the conventional pricing URL yielded no page, and the sales destination is an enquiry page without plans or prices: https://verticalinsure.com/ and https://verticalinsure.com/contact-us/. A third-party G2 pricing listing exists, but no company-hosted pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company’s case studies describe Goodshuffle and MySlabs actually implementing its embedded-insurance products, rather than merely appearing as investors or general partners. Sources: https://verticalinsure.com/partner-stories/goodshuffle-event-host-liability and https://verticalinsure.com/partner-stories/partner-story-how-myslabs-and-vertical-insure-built-a-unique-insurance-solution-designed-for-collectibles. | named_customers.0: The case study describes Goodshuffle implementing Vertical Insure’s event-host liability and rental coverage products: https://verticalinsure.com/partner-stories/goodshuffle-event-host-liability. | named_customers.1: The case study describes MySlabs embedding Vertical Insure’s Shipping Protection into its marketplace: https://verticalinsure.com/partner-stories/partner-story-how-myslabs-and-vertical-insure-built-a-unique-insurance-solution-designed-for-collectibles.

employee_band.notes: LeadIQ reports approximately 52 employees as of October 2026, placing the company in the 51-100 band: https://leadiq.com/c/vertical-insure/638f49db19e0e0895b2b596e.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s careers page explicitly identifies its Minneapolis headquarters: https://verticalinsure.com/careers. | hq_country: The company profile identifies its headquarters location as Minneapolis, Minnesota, US: https://linkedin.com/company/vertical-insure.

founded_year.notes: Preqin explicitly states that Vertical Insure was founded in 2022: https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/vertical-insure--inc-/529375.

eng_blog.notes: The blog and Insights indexes present insurance, industry and product-strategy content, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built: https://verticalinsure.com/blog and https://verticalinsure.com/insights.

public_docs.notes: The public developer site provides documentation and API reference, with separate Quick Start, Authentication, Testing & Debugging, Payments and other articles: https://docs.verticalinsure.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board lists nine openings across all departments and locations. None of the nine titles is an AI, ML or data-science role under the requested title criteria: https://ats.rippling.com/vertical-insure/jobs.

model_provider.notes: Implementation partner Blank Metal publicly states that it rebuilt Vertical Insure’s location-intelligence system using OpenAI models: https://tsw.blankmetal.ai/p/vertical-insure-transforms-risk-assessment. This is partner-published implementation evidence.
